1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent, __wherein the thermally conductive binder is not a thermally conductive epoxy__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and the binder comprises a material selected from the group consisting of solder paste, ceramic glue, and polymeric binders__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the cavity-generating particles are affixed to the electronic component surface by the binder__.
